svg.title: Arcade: the last 12 months of contributions as a game level
svg.desc: A pixel-art arcade screen. The level is Sariya's real contribution calendar: a pixel lens clears it day by day, filters out three noise sprites and counts the score up to 697 contributions. Best day: 23. Longest streak: 11 days. Press start for three data games on sariyarizwan.com.
svg.text: FIND THE SIGNAL IN THE NOISE
